AboutPage.meta_desc: Nexflow — formerly Eurojob-West. Since 2013 connecting workers with logistics companies on both sides of the Polish-German border.
AboutPage.hero_desc: Since 2013 we've been connecting workers with logistics companies on both sides of the Polish-German border. We've done it thousands of times — with commitment, on time, legally.
AboutPage.story_heading: DE-PL corridor — this is our home turf
AboutPage.story_p1: Nexflow (formerly Eurojob-West) is a staffing agency specialising in the warehouse and logistics sector in Poland and Germany. We are rooted at the border — physically and operationally.
AboutPage.story_p2: We don't operate in every market or serve every industry. We focus on what we know best: warehousing, logistics, transport — on both sides of the Oder River.
AboutPage.story_p3: This focus translates into a real competitive advantage: the fastest placement time in the industry, deep knowledge of local labour regulations, and an active pool of over 240 verified workers ready to start today.
AboutPage.history_subheading: Over 10 years at the intersection of two economies.
AboutPage.m2013_desc: We start as Eurojob-West — a small agency on the Polish-German border, specialising in connecting Polish workers with warehouse companies in Germany.
AboutPage.m2015_desc: We open full operations on the Polish side. We begin serving Polish logistics companies — both by providing workers and recruiting permanent staff for them.
AboutPage.m2018_desc: We cross the threshold of 100 simultaneously active temporary workers. We launch an internal compliance documentation tracking system.
AboutPage.m2022_desc: We expand recruitment to new markets — Indonesia, Nigeria, Ghana, Colombia, Philippines. Today we manage workers from over 21 countries.
AboutPage.m2026_desc: Rebranding. Eurojob-West becomes Nexflow — with a new brand, a digital platform in development and an ambitious plan to scale operations across the entire DE-PL corridor.
AboutPage.values_subheading: What we believe in as a company is reflected in everything we do — from the first call to the last document.
AboutPage.v1_desc: 5 business days is not a marketing slogan — it's our operational standard. We achieve it thanks to an active, constantly refreshed pool of verified workers.
AboutPage.v2_desc: We operate at the intersection of two legal systems. Every worker has all documents before the first shift — permits, A1, ZUS. No exceptions.
AboutPage.v3_desc: 240+ active workers from 21+ countries. Poland, Ukraine, Indonesia, Nigeria, Ghana, Colombia, Philippines — every person verified, ready to work.
AboutPage.v4_desc: One contact person, one number. We don't process requests through forms — we talk directly to clients and workers, because that's how trust is built.
AboutPage.cta_desc: Tell us about your staffing challenge. We'll get back to you the same day with a concrete proposal.
